name: rvcsi
description: rvCSI marketplace: a Claude Code plugin for the edge RF sensing runtime — capture, validate, inspect, replay, run the DSP + event pipeline, decode Nexmon CSI, and work with the CsiFrame/CsiWindow/CsiEvent schema.

plugins.name: rvcsi
plugins.description: rvCSI toolkit: record/transcode CSI into validated .rvcsi captures, inspect them, replay them, run the DSP + event pipeline (presence/motion/anomaly/baseline-drift), decode Broadcom chanspecs and list Nexmon chips, learn calibration baselines, export to RuVector RF memory — plus an agent that knows the normalized schema, the validation rules, and the CsiSource adapter contract (ADR-095, ADR-096).
